files.first_when_bit_sample.fsm:
(?fsm:first_when_bit_sample

  (+system
    (clock clk)
    (sreset rst_n active_low)
  )

  (+interface
    (input request)
    (input allow)
    (input datain)
    (input other)
    (output seen)
    (output done)
  )

  (+size
    (request 1)
    (allow 1)
    (datain 3)
    (other 3)
    (seen 3)
    (done 1)
    (can_accept 1)
  )

  (main_idle_0
    (= (can_accept 1))
    (<= (captured other) <(!= (& datain 3'd2) 3'd0))
    (-> main_done_1 <(!= (& datain 3'd2) 3'd0))
  )

  (main_done_1
    (<1 (done> 1))
    (-> main_idle_0)
  )

)

source:
(actor first_when_bit_sample
  (clock clk) (reset (rst_n sync active_low))
  (interface (input request) (input allow) (input datain (width 3)) (input other (width 3)) (output seen (width 3)) (output done))
  
  (transaction main  (when-bit datain 1 (sample other as captured)) (complete done)))
